fee_notes: Single traditional restaurant: $35,000 lump sum at signing. Under a Development Agreement, the second and each subsequent restaurant is $20,000. In 2025, a small number of additional franchises were sold to existing franchisees for $20,000. From time to time, fees may be negotiated below $35,000 for multi-unit commitments or high-performing existing franchisees. Non-traditional Walmart sublease locations involve a $12,000 security deposit (refundable) plus a subleased premises improvement charge of $10,000–$150,000. A $5,000 grand opening advertising fee is also required. All fees except the sublease security deposit are non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us a lump sum payment of $35,000 when you sign the Franchise Agreement for a single traditional Wayback Burgers restaurant franchise. If you enter into a Development Agreement, the initial franchise fee for the second and each subsequent restaurant you open pursuant to the Development Agreement will be $20,000. ... In 2025, we sold a small number of additional franchises to existing franchisees for $20,000.
